title: tests found implementation bugs
details: - TC-INSTK-1-10: expected After clicking "In stock only" on /, the address bar contains inStock=true, got The address bar is http://localhost:29080/?inStock=True; filtering, the 90-product count and the 10 pages are correct (NavigationManager.GetUriWithQueryParameters formats the boxed bool true as "True", so the URL does not match the inStock=true the verified case, the API parameter, CatalogService and the implementation notes all use. The same click and check in TC-INSTK-1-12 and TC-INSTK-1-18 fail the same way. Passing the string "true" would fix it.) at src/WebAppComponents/Catalog/CatalogSearch.razor:180 (InStockUri: { "inStock", InStock ? null : true })
